title: UCOPE P07: propose a learned-return information-value comparison
context: After valid B01 NR-B, DM recommends a separately scoped B question using a count-conditioned return model, a count-blind model trained on the same paid episodes, and IMMEDIATE-4. One fresh shared-data pair with sampled native gains over both references could support bounded follow-up. This is a recommendation for the next DM preparation task; no card, investment disposition, provider Send, experiment or new budget is selected.

evidence_for.quote: The bounded conclusion is that this specific sampled-return actor, optimizer, 1,024-update budget and modal evaluation failed to show improvement on these two training seeds.
evidence_for.why: 已有结果限定一个学习器与预算，尚未回答普通条件回报模型能否把信息转化为净收益。

evidence_for.quote: The information-blind model is important: training uses the same exploratory episodes and full reward labels for both models.
evidence_for.why: 盲模型控制相同训练数据与费用；立即承诺另行防止仅击败弱比较器就宣称有效。

evidence_against.quote: There is no tuned generic current-host headroom record; this oracle/reference diagnostic is not a substitute for one.
evidence_against.why: 可用收益很小；此提案也只在有限信息流主机上探索，不能直接支持多智能体或稳定优越性结论。

uncertainty: 样本均值中的最大值选择可能高估探测收益，必须看独立采样的最终原生回报。
一个独立数据种子只能支持小规模后续投入，不能估计稳定训练总体优越性。
新学习器运行时间尚未测量，B01耗时不能当作保证。
